subject: Animation
title: Isao Takahata: Ghibli's Other Genius
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Isao Takahata: Ghibli's Other Genius.

hook.text: Isao Takahata cofounded Studio Ghibli with Miyazaki, but his films explored radically different territory.

buildup.text: Grave of the Fireflies, his 1988 masterpiece, is considered one of the greatest anti-war films ever made.

discovery.text: Unlike Miyazaki's fantasy worlds, Takahata grounded his films in painful realism and quiet human moments.

twist.text: Takahata's final film, The Tale of the Princess Kaguya, took eight years to make and nearly bankrupted Ghibli.

climax.text: Takahata proved animation could be as emotionally devastating as any live-action drama ever filmed.

punchline.text: Ghibli's quieter cofounder made animation's most heartbreaking film.

quiz.question: How did Isao Takahata's approach differ from Miyazaki's?
options: He grounded his films in painful realism and quiet human moments rather than fantasy worlds
